channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Web Search on Amazon Bedrock is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West)
item.description: The Web Search built-in server-side tool on Amazon Bedrock is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West), helping bring grounded web results to compliance-sensitive government and public-sector workloads. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Second-generation AWS Outposts racks now in the AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
item.description: Second-generation AWS Outposts racks are now supported in the AWS GovCloud (US-East) and AWS GovCloud (US-West) Regions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Config now supports 60 new resource types
item.description: AWS Config now supports 60 additional AWS resource types across key services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon EC2, Amazon SageMaker, and AWS Organizations. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer expands automated performance evaluations to Malay
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer now automates evaluations of human and AI agents in Malay using generative AI. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Quick adds new tool settings and Model Context Protocol (MCP) sync support for connectors
item.description: Amazon Quick connectors let users leverage tools and services such as Outlook, Slack, Salesforce, Jira, and homegrown MCP servers directly into their workflows across chat, agents, apps, flows, and deep research. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer announces general availability of agentic CX designer
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer announces the general availability of agentic CX designer, a no-code canvas for designing and deploying AI-powered self-service experiences. (1 source: aws)
